To further assess the proposed model, we conduct a human evaluation. We compare CBART (greedy decoding) with GBS, CGMH, X-MCMC-C, POINTER-2 and human references. For each model, we randomly select 50 sentences to compare the sentences generated by different models. Following previous work, each annotator should compare sentence A with sentence B and decide which one is more fluent or informative. A tie is allowed if they have no preference.
